Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing certain capital and surplus requirements necessary to transact insurance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the capital and surplus requirements necessaryto transact insurance; and amending RCW 48.05.340.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 48.05.340 and 2005 c 223 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:
